name: Weekly Glacier maintenance proposal
goal: Check dependencies and the test board, then save one proposal note. This flow never changes the repository.

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import datetime,os,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'vault'/'proposals'/('maintenance-'+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).date().isoformat()+'.md'); s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Weekly maintenance proposal' in s and 'Nothing was installed or changed' in s"
